title: Counties, Rivers & Cities - Megyék, folyók és városok

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the 19 counties (vármegyék) and explain how Budapest forms an autonomous capital.
I can explain how the Danube and Tisza divide and shape Hungary's two main regions (Dunántúl and Alföld).
I can describe Lake Balaton, its geography, and its cultural role as the 'magyar tenger'.
I can name key regional cities (such as Debrecen, Szeged, Pécs, Győr, and Székesfehérvár) and their locations.
I can use spatial postpositions (mentén, mellett, között, túl) in formal geographical descriptions.
